minutes.headline: Water commissioners backed buying two Styles meters for a bulk water fill point out back; motion made and seconded.
minutes.summary: The commissioners approved prior minutes, heard that businesses will have engineers draw plans for a new main extension, and discussed replacing the Cleartech server contract. They chose a Styles meter quote for bulk water sales and saw no need to restrict outside water use. They also discussed how to recover the cost of a broken window from two boys' parents.

votes.motion: Purchase two meters from Styles out of the water maintenance account, for the bulk water fill point out back.

budget_items.what_was_said: Quarterly charge for server contract is up for renewal; staff are unhappy because the setup was costly and want to look elsewhere. Cloud options were raised.
figures_as_heard: seven hundred and eight dollars a year

budget_items.topic: Meter quotes from Styles and Thai Sales
budget_items.what_was_said: Styles includes an optional ten-year app program for reading flow data. Ultrasonic meter is much dearer than a propeller meter and is not needed for steady full flow.

budget_items.topic: Meter purchase from water maintenance account
budget_items.what_was_said: Motion to buy the two Styles meters from the water maintenance account.
Glass cost was small and staff is installing it; discussed billing parents and possibly including staff overtime.
The extension is said to cost the district nothing.

transfers.description: Purchase of two meters charged to the water maintenance account

decisions.decision: Businesses will have engineers draw plans for a main extension; the plans return to the commissioners for approval.
Do not sign the Cleartech renewal yet; look at other options including cloud, as the contract is not due until about July.
No restrictions or discussion on outside bulk water use now; to be watched and revisited if excessive draw occurs.
Staff asked how to recover broken-window cost; both mothers said to bill them. No final decision heard.

what_happened.line: A motion to buy two Styles meters for the bulk water fill point out back, paid from the water maintenance account, was made and seconded; the vote was not audible.
Commissioners chose to hold off signing the Cleartech server contract renewal and to look at other options, including cloud, since it is not due until about July.
Businesses will have engineers draw plans for a new main extension, and the plans will come back to the commissioners for approval.
Commissioners placed no restrictions on outside bulk water use for now, to be revisited if draw proves excessive.
Staff asked how to recover the cost of a broken window; both mothers said to bill them, and no final decision was heard.

why_it_matters: The meter purchase would come from the water maintenance account, so it bears on how the district equips a bulk water fill point and on what that account pays for.
The server contract and the main extension both bear on district costs: the extension was described as costing the district nothing, and the contract has not been renewed.
